artworks.label: Dendritic snow crystal
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for glacier-quiet. One exquisite natural dendritic snow crystal in close macro view, six intricately branched translucent ice arms with delicate stepped facets and tiny frost beads, subtly tilted in three-quarter view to reveal real crystalline depth. Fine-art glacial macro photography, soft cool mist light, pale steel-blue/icy-cyan/white palette, quiet realistic ice texture. No typography, emblem styling, icons, feathers, bubbles or iceberg; a natural physical snow crystal. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
